objective: maximize net profit from published assets by improving conversion, average order value and lifetime value while preserving measurement integrity

observedBaseline.decision: No live repricing or visual experiment is authorized tonight because there is no observed product-level sales, PV, acquisition, install or conversion baseline.

crossSellAudit.policy: Keep one context-matched CTA after the free core workflow. Do not add unrelated or competing CTAs without click/conversion evidence.

experiments.currentProblem: Existing prices range from 480 to 1280 JPY, but no article-level PV/sales data exist.
experiments.change: Test 1,480-1,980 JPY on future high-value practical articles while retaining lower-priced entry products.
experiments.expectedAOVDelta: directionally positive if conversion remains acceptable; no numeric estimate without data
experiments.expectedLTVDelta: potentially positive through clearer entry/standard/premium roles
experiments.requiredSample: Comparable article PV and paid sales across matched exposure windows; do not interpret zero/one purchase as elasticity evidence.
experiments.risk: Higher price can reduce conversion if value promise is weak or trust is insufficient.
experiments.rollback: Return future comparable products to the lower band if revenue per view materially underperforms after sufficient traffic.

experiments.currentProblem: Coherent complementary single products exist but there is no sales evidence proving bundle demand.
experiments.change: Keep current singles unchanged; prepare bundles only after a credible theme demand signal, with bundle price above each single and genuine combined workflow value.
experiments.requiredSample: Observed theme/product sales plus bundle-versus-single revenue after launch.
experiments.risk: Cannibalization and loss of demand attribution.
experiments.rollback: Retain singles independently and withdraw/reprice any bundle that reduces net revenue.

experiments.currentProblem: Final Store identity/submission is not complete, so no Store URL or baseline exists.
experiments.change: Complete identity and screenshots first; after publication, record Store page views, acquisitions, installs, conversion and health before the first visual experiment. Add source-specific campaign IDs to external links.
experiments.requiredSample: Sufficient baseline traffic to distinguish real variation from noise; no arbitrary threshold invented.
experiments.risk: Changing multiple listing elements before a baseline destroys attribution.
experiments.rollback: Preserve the initial certified listing as control and revert underperforming experiment variants.
